name: Heide (Germany)
description: Red field with a narrow white stripe near the top and bottom edges, charged with the white figures of the city arms of Heide without a shield: Saint George on horseback slaying the dragon, between an anchor and a plant.
history: The flag shows in red the figures of the city arms all in white without shield, accompanied above and below near the edge by a narrow white stripe; the meaning of the anchor is unexplained but probably goes back to the Wollersmannen.

features.role: Saint George on horseback slaying the dragon
